title: fewer and less
rule: Fewer is for countable plurals: fewer mistakes. Less is for uncountables: less time. Less is also used with amounts of money and time that are treated as a single quantity: less than ten minutes.
ruleRu: Fewer — со считаемым множественным: fewer mistakes. Less — с несчитаемым: less time.
exampleOk: There are fewer cars and less noise.
exampleBad: There are less cars and fewer noise.
l1Trap: Less ставят ко всему, потому что «меньше» одно.

title: on time and in time
rule: On time means at the planned hour, not late and not early. In time means early enough for a purpose. The train left on time. We arrived in time to catch it.
ruleRu: On time — точно по расписанию. In time — успеть к чему-то. The train was on time. We arrived in time to catch it.
exampleOk: I got there in time for the start, and the film began on time.
exampleBad: I got there on time for catching the film, it began in time.

title: in the end and at the end
titleRu: In the end и at the end
rule: In the end means finally, after all. At the end means at the last point of something. In the end we walked. At the end of the film the hero dies.
ruleRu: In the end — в итоге. At the end — в конечной точке чего-то. At the end of the film.
exampleOk: At the end of the street, turn left. In the end we took a taxi.
exampleBad: In the end of the street, turn left.
l1Trap: In the end of строят по русскому «в конце улицы».

title: during
rule: During plus a noun means inside that period. During the lesson, during the summer. It is not followed by a clause and it does not replace for. I slept during the film. I slept for two hours.
ruleRu: During и существительное — внутри этого отрезка. During the film. Длительность — for, не during two hours.
exampleOk: She called me during the meeting.
exampleBad: She called me during I was in the meeting.
l1Trap: После during ставят целое предложение, как после while.

title: still and yet
rule: Still means the situation continues, and it goes before the main verb or after be. Yet in negatives and questions means up to now, usually at the end. She is still here. She hasn't left yet.
ruleRu: Still — всё ещё, перед глаголом или после be. Yet — «ещё» в вопросе и отрицании, обычно в конце.
exampleOk: Are you still working? Have you finished yet?
exampleBad: Are you yet working? Have you finished still?
l1Trap: Still и yet оба «ещё», и их ставят не на своё место.

title: clothes, police, scissors
rule: Clothes, police and scissors take a plural verb and have no ordinary singular. The clothes are wet. The police are here. For one item, use a piece of clothing, a police officer, a pair of scissors.
ruleRu: Clothes, police и scissors требуют глагол во множественном. Одна штука — a piece of clothing, a police officer, a pair of scissors.
exampleOk: These scissors are blunt. My clothes are in the bag.
exampleBad: This scissor is blunt. My cloth are in the bag.
l1Trap: Слова выглядят как единственное или, наоборот, cloth путают с clothes.

title: history and hair
rule: Hair, homework, luggage and history (the subject) are normally uncountable. Her hair is long. Not her hairs are long, unless you mean a few separate strands.
ruleRu: Hair, homework и history как предмет обычно не считаются. Her hair is long. Не her hairs.
exampleOk: My hair is wet and the homework is on the table.
exampleBad: My hairs are wet and the homeworks are on the table.
l1Trap: По-русски «волосы» во множественном, и hairs становится нормой.

title: remember to and remember doing
rule: Remember to do is about the future: don't forget this duty. Remember doing is a memory of the past. Remember to lock the door. I remember locking it.
ruleRu: Remember to — не забыть сделать. Remember doing — помнить, что уже сделал. Remember to lock. I remember locking.
exampleOk: Did you remember to call her? I remember calling her yesterday.
exampleBad: Did you remember calling her before you leave?
l1Trap: Обе формы переводят «помнить», и обязанность путают с воспоминанием.

title: quite and quiet
rule: Quite means fairly or completely: quite good, quite sure. Quiet means without noise. The house is quiet. I'm quite tired.
ruleRu: Quite — «довольно» или «совсем». Quiet — «тихий». The house is quiet. I'm quite tired.
exampleOk: It's quite late and the street is quiet.
exampleBad: It's quiet late and the street is quite.
l1Trap: Слова пишут одно вместо другого, потому что звучат похоже.

title: sensible and sensitive
rule: Sensible means having good judgment. Sensitive means easily hurt or able to feel small changes. A sensible decision. Sensitive skin. Not a sensitive plan when you mean a wise one.
ruleRu: Sensible — разумный. Sensitive — чувствительный. A sensible decision. Sensitive skin.
exampleOk: It was sensible to leave. She has sensitive teeth.
exampleBad: It was sensitive to leave early.

title: between and among
rule: Between is for two people or things, or for distinct items you can separate. Among is for a mass or a group you do not separate. Between you and me. Among the crowd.
ruleRu: Between — двое или отдельные вещи, которые можно различить. Among — внутри массы или толпы. Between you and me. Among the crowd.
exampleOk: The letter is between the books, somewhere among my papers.
exampleBad: The letter is among the two books.
l1Trap: Оба значат «между», и among ставят даже про двоих.

title: prefer
rule: Prefer takes a noun, to plus verb, or verb-ing. The comparison uses to, not than: I prefer tea to coffee. I prefer walking to driving.
ruleRu: Prefer сравнивает через to, не than. I prefer tea to coffee. I prefer walking to driving.
exampleOk: I prefer reading to watching television.
exampleBad: I prefer reading than watching television.
l1Trap: Than переносят из сравнительной степени: prefer tea than coffee.

title: the plus adjective
titleRu: The и прилагательное про группу людей
rule: The plus an adjective can mean a whole group of people: the rich, the poor, the young, the unemployed. The verb is plural. The rich are not always happy.
ruleRu: The и прилагательное может значить целую группу: the rich, the young. Глагол во множественном. The rich are not always happy.
exampleOk: The unemployed are looking for work.
l1Trap: Артикль the перед группой пропускают, и глагол ставят в единственном.

title: suggest
rule: Suggest takes verb-ing, or that plus a clause. It does not take a person plus to. She suggested leaving. She suggested that we leave. Not She suggested me to leave and not She suggested to leave.
ruleRu: Suggest принимает -ing или that и придаточное. Не suggest me to и не suggest to leave.
exampleBad: He suggested me to take a break.
l1Trap: Suggest строят как advise someone to.
